sourceFormat: MATLAB saved CSV, with companion MAT digests

provenance.method: Prescribed-speed backward quasi-static engineering model; custom synthetic cycles; not certified CLTC/WLTC.
provenance.precision: Every numeric CSV cell is parsed as an IEEE-754 double without rounding or resampling; MATLAB CSV serialization precision is retained. NaN/Inf become JSON null, never zero.
provenance.matUsage: Companion MAT files are hashed for provenance only. Numeric JSON values come from the saved CSV exports; no MATLAB simulation is rerun.
provenance.caution: Reference speed and reference distance are not achieved vehicle motion. Feasible is copied from the official summary. Internal parts and efficiencies are educational approximations.
provenance.feasibilityRule: Saved MATLAB summary: Unmet_kWh < 1e-4 and AuxUnmet_kWh < 1e-4. No web-side reclassification.
